title: Verify lore-cli/quest-cli v0.6.0 tag recreation preserves skill content
summary: opum-agent warned: lore-cli and quest-cli are being deleted and recreated tonight (user-authorized, to purge undeletable refs/pull/* refs that served stale CLAUDE.md content). This destroys and recreates the v0.6.0 tag both marketplace.json entries pin, and the recreated tag points at a fresh initial commit (current tree, not the real 0.6.0 release history) -- risking marketplace.json's federated-entry descriptions ('cannot drift from the CLI it describes') becoming quietly false, since check-federated-pins.mjs only checks version match, not content fidelity against a pre-deletion baseline.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Before either deletion: capture a verifiable baseline for both repos' v0.6.0 -- full ref chain (tag object -> commit -> tree -> named subtrees for .claude-plugin/ and skills/), plus the actual tarball bytes, since a hash alone can't be resolved back into content once the source is deleted. Done: baseline-lore-v0.6.0.tar.gz (3.07MB), baseline-quest-v0.6.0.tar.gz (199.9MB), full chain recorded.

quest-cli's recreated v0.6.0 verified directly against the live repo (not taken from any relay, including a well-evidenced one) -- full ref chain re-resolved myself: tag object f1a75ab4 -> commit a9fbc78a -> skills subtree 633c776b (EXACT match to baseline, byte-identical) -> .claude-plugin subtree 22885902 (differs from baseline 393318c5). plugin.json content pulled directly: only author.name changed, 'Opum' -> 'Opum AI' -- the OPAG-70 branding pass, landed correctly per the fleet's own naming taxonomy (Opum AI = company). Nothing else in plugin.json changed; version still 0.6.0, matching its own tag name.

Decide whether marketplace.json needs an edit for quest-cli's entry, given the finding. It does not: this repo's opum-quest entry already reads author.name 'Opum AI' (OMARK-37) -- manifest and plugin now agree, where they briefly would not have. Source pins by tag NAME ('ref': 'v0.6.0'), not a SHA, so tag recreation under the same name needed no marketplace-side change for federation to keep resolving. The description's 'cannot drift' claim survives in substance: the skill content itself (skills/) is unchanged.

lore-cli's side: same live verification, now done -- its deletion/recreation happened 2026-09-11T00:03Z and the outcome was NOT assumed from quest-cli's. Full chain re-resolved directly against the live repo, not taken from lore-cli's relay: refs/tags/v0.6.0 -> tag object 800873f7 (annotated) -> commit e3d75867 (root, zero parents, 'chore: fresh history for the public repository') -> root tree 92265cf0 -> skills subtree 24277e9a94d6cc9b5a8c7fa12fa32c4f15eb4c0f, EXACT match to baseline; .claude-plugin subtree 311e8a67 vs baseline dd7fe86d, differs. Difference resolved to bytes, not left at the SHA: live plugin.json (blob 41aa5ea9, 591B) diffed against the pre-deletion tarball's copy (588B) is a ONE-LINE change, author.name 'Opum' -> 'Opum AI' -- the OPAG-70 branding pass. Nothing else: name, version 0.6.0, description, url, homepage, repository, license, keywords all byte-identical. Skills byte-identity proven independently of both the recorded baseline note and lore-cli's claim: re-hashing the pre-deletion tarball's skills/ directory locally with git write-tree reproduces 24277e9a exactly. skills/lore/SKILL.md = blob feda4a6b, 4823B, front-matter 'name: lore' on both sides. Same shape as quest-cli (AC2), confirmed rather than presumed. No marketplace.json edit needed: the opum-lore entry already reads author.name 'Opum AI' (OMARK-37), so manifest and plugin agree; the pin is by tag NAME 'v0.6.0', not a SHA, so recreation under the same name kept federation resolving. check-federated-pins.mjs: 'federated pins OK (3 plugin(s) checked)'. The 'cannot drift from the CLI it describes' claim holds in substance for both entries -- skill content is unchanged across the history reset.

finalSummary: Both federated pins verified against pre-deletion baselines after the v0.6.0 tag recreations. quest-cli (AC2) and lore-cli (AC4) each re-resolved live, independently, tag object -> commit -> root tree -> named subtrees. Both outcomes identical in shape: skills/ subtree byte-identical to baseline (quest 633c776b, lore 24277e9a), .claude-plugin/ differing by exactly one line, author.name 'Opum' -> 'Opum AI' (OPAG-70 branding). For lore-cli the skills byte-identity was proven without trusting either the recorded baseline note or the owning session's relay: re-hashing the saved pre-deletion tarball's skills/ directory locally reproduces tree 24277e9a exactly. No marketplace.json edit needed -- both entries already carry author.name 'Opum AI' (OMARK-37), and both pins are by tag NAME, not SHA, so recreation under the same name kept federation resolving. check-federated-pins.mjs reports 'federated pins OK (3 plugin(s) checked)'. The entries' 'cannot drift from the CLI it describes' claim survives the history reset in substance: the skill content itself is unchanged in both repos.
